rationale: The current Cloud aggregate table continues to give ES 8.6+ and the detailed current task gives ES 8.7+. The current task retains assistant enablement, paired SOAR, investigation visibility and the existing triaged finding condition. CMP lists Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The exact 2.3.6 Enterprise installation and SAIA-9918 sections both say 2.2.0–2.3.6 do not support Cloud Connected installation and describe 2.4.0 as planned. The indexed SOC setup prerequisite states SAIA 2.4+; its direct URL remains unavailable. Neither the English nor alternate-locale 8.8 notes retrieved in this attempt establishes the historical October CA wording. Current GA and historical CA remain separate, and the current Premier description does not restore the old Essentials wording.
